brief:
Israel has seized a vocational training centre operated by the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the occupied East Jerusalem area of Kalandia, UNRWA warned. The facility provided skills training and vocational education to hundreds of Palestinian young people seeking pathways into employment.

The closure leaves Palestinians without access to programmes designed to equip them with marketable skills and prepare them for the job market. UNRWA said the seizure will have significant consequences for youth development in the territory. The agency did not specify when the takeover occurred or disclose Israeli justification for the action.
dek: The seizure of a vocational training centre in occupied East Jerusalem has left hundreds of Palestinian young people without access to skills and training that could help shape their futures.
title: Israel seizes UNRWA vocational training centre in East Jerusalem
